tasks.title: Restore deleted test suite from git
tasks.description: test/tests/*.py (and test/ files) are tracked in git but deleted on disk. Restore them from HEAD (git restore --source=HEAD -- test/ or git checkout HEAD -- test/) and run the full suite `python -m unittest discover -s test/tests -v` to confirm a green baseline BEFORE any UI edits. Do not commit anything yet.

tasks.title: Layout: unify Terminal Logs into single window
tasks.description: Restructure scripts/web_app.py so the right Terminal Logs rail (w-96) is integrated into the main workplane as a bottom console panel below the chat area, forming one unified single-window workspace with NO dead zones between chat, console, and input. Keep element ids #canvasOut and #canvasTag and the literal label 'Terminal Logs' (tests assert it). Adjust JS (renderCanvas / SSE wiring) only if element references move; API endpoints unchanged.

tasks.title: Layout: compact spacing, remove dead zones
tasks.description: Remove redundant empty spaces in scripts/web_app.py: tighten top-bar and tab-header paddings, chat container padding (px-4 py-4 space-y-4), card paddings, quick-actions row, input area, and the sidebar's flex-1 spacer. Chat + console + input must form one compact continuous column with no empty gaps.

tasks.title: Theme: dark theme polish
tasks.description: Refine the dark theme in scripts/web_app.py PAGE_HTML: consistent border/radius treatment, subtle panel elevation/separation, improved hover/active/focus states for buttons, pills, nav items, inputs, and selects; polished status dots, scrollbars, and settings modal. Keep the palette's spirit (bg/panel/panel2/edge/accent/lime) unless a clear refinement improves it; keep contrast high.

tasks.title: Responsiveness across breakpoints
tasks.description: Make scripts/web_app.py responsive: sidebar collapses/hides on narrow widths; console stacks below chat; settings modal scrolls and fits; provider matrix grid adapts (sm/lg already present); input and quick-actions wrap cleanly. Verify usable at ~360px and ~1920px widths.

tasks.title: End-to-end verification pass
tasks.description: Run the full suite: `python -m unittest discover -s test/tests -v` (exit 0). Headless smoke: start `python scripts/web_app.py --no-browser --port 8512`, GET / returns 200 with expected markers, GET /api/catalog and /api/status work, POST /api/route preview works; then stop the server. Confirm `git status --short` shows no test deletions or stray files and no secrets.
